title: session-load's arm B adds the kbmon pane's own commands on the pane's schedule, so the monitor's share is measured
goal: python3 _tools/benchmarks.py run session-load --arms B runs arm A plus the commands the kbmon-pane mod runs in an interactive session (kbmon.py --once, then --status all, as .claude/skills/kbmon-pane/hooks/register.tsx does), the first after FIRST_MS and then every --pane-every seconds (default the mod's REFRESH_MS) over a --window of seconds per phase, and writes per phase a pane_runs row and the kbmon class's cpu_s, rss_peak_mb, rss_mean_mb and spawns_per_min beside arm A's; arm A runs no pane command; and kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv holds a 5-rep record of arm B at the default schedule

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import csv, os, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
B = os.path.join(T, 'bin'); os.mkdir(B)
open(os.path.join(B, 'claude'), 'w').write('#!/bin/sh\nexit 1\n')
os.chmod(os.path.join(B, 'claude'), 0o755)
ENV = dict(os.environ, PATH=B + os.pathsep + os.environ['PATH'])
out = os.path.join(T, 'out.csv')
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/benchmarks.py', 'run', 'session-load', '--arms', 'A,B', '--reps', '1',
                    '--window', '12', '--pane-every', '5', '--out', out], capture_output=True, text=True, env=ENV, timeout=1800)
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open(out, encoding='utf-8'))) if os.path.exists(out) else []
shutil.rmtree(T, ignore_errors=True)
assert p.returncode == 0, ('run session-load --arms A,B exit', p.returncode, p.stderr[-400:])
rows = [r for r in rows if r['scenario'] == 'session-load']
assert not [r for r in rows if r['metric'] in ('errors', 'spend_usd')], 'an errors or spend row'
val = {(r['case'], r['arm'], r['metric']): float(r['value']) for r in rows}
for case in ('idle', 'working'):
    assert val.get((case + ' all', 'B', 'pane_runs'), 0) >= 2, ('fewer than 2 pane runs in a 12 s window every 5 s', case)
    assert val.get((case + ' kbmon', 'B', 'cpu_s'), 0) > 0, ('no kbmon cpu_s in arm B', case)
    assert (case + ' kbmon', 'A', 'cpu_s') not in val or val[(case + ' kbmon', 'A', 'cpu_s')] == 0, ('arm A ran the pane', case)
    assert val[(case + ' all', 'B', 'cpu_s')] > val[(case + ' all', 'A', 'cpu_s')], ('arm B costs no more than A', case)

Scale the pane's figures to a session of NOMINAL_S
